original_text: Veli\v{c}kovi\'{c}~et~al.~\cite{velivckovic2018gat} proposed Graph Attention Networks (GATs), enabling adaptive neighbour weighting through attention mechanisms.
injected_text: Veli\v{c}kovi\'{c}~et~al.~\cite{velivckovic2018gat} proposed Graph Attention Networks (GATs), demonstrating that they achieve near-optimal max-min fairness for resource block allocation in cellular networks.
rationale: The edit simulates a tired author confusing a foundational machine learning methods paper with a domain-specific wireless networking application by replacing the accurate description of GATs with a claim about cellular network resource allocation.
ground_truth_description: The claim attached to the Velickovic et al. citation was rewritten to assert that the paper evaluates cellular network resource allocation, a topic entirely absent from the original paper.

truth.claim_sentence_verbatim: Veli\v{c}kovi\'{c}~et~al.~\cite{velivckovic2018gat} proposed Graph Attention Networks (GATs), enabling adaptive neighbour weighting through attention mechanisms.

rationale: The paper lacks any explicit 'base × percent = result' triples to perturb for a percent_of error. I injected a percent_to_100 error instead (changing the test split to 25% so the splits sum to 115%, ensuring >10% deviation for the major/S2 severity target) as the closest realistic alternative.
ground_truth_description: Changed the dataset test split from 10% to 25%, causing the train/validation/test splits to incorrectly sum to 115%.

rationale: The link capacity constraint gates flow on the binary selection variable via the product C_ij * x_ij, so an unselected link (x_ij=0) forces zero flow. Replacing the product with a sum C_ij + x_ij is structurally similar but destroys the gating: an unselected link would still admit flow up to its full capacity, contradicting the relay-selection model the text describes. Perturbs the existing constraint in place rather than appending anything.
ground_truth_description: Capacity constraint changed from f_ij <= C_ij * x_ij to f_ij <= C_ij + x_ij, removing the binary gating of link flow.

truth.term_role: capacity gating term (product of capacity and binary selector)

original_text:
\subsection{Greedy SNR Baseline}

As a reference method, a greedy SNR-based strategy is considered.
Each CAV selects the feasible outgoing link with the highest SNR,
subject to capacity and hop constraints.
injected_text:
\subsection{Greedy Distance Baseline}

As a reference method, a greedy distance-based strategy is considered.
Each CAV selects the feasible outgoing link with the shortest geographical distance,
subject to capacity and hop constraints.
rationale: The Methods section now defines the baseline as a distance-based heuristic, directly contradicting the Results section which explicitly evaluates and discusses a greedy SNR-based baseline.
ground_truth_description: Changed the description of the baseline method in Section IV from SNR-based to distance-based, creating a contradiction with the Results section.
